purpose: Small, explicit set of rule records checked against official admissions sources. Absence of a rule means unknown, not ineligible.

conditional_subject_alternatives.condition: Pre-medical applicants are eligible for the FAST computing domain if they have passed additional Mathematics or are awaiting its result under the published FAST policy.
conditional_subject_alternatives.required_follow_up: Confirm additional Mathematics result status and the active intake instructions with FAST-NUCES.

rules.note: This is minimum eligibility for the 2026 cycle, not a closing-merit cutoff or admission guarantee. The published page lists BS AI within the computing domain. Campus availability and the active admission window must be confirmed separately.

conditional_subject_alternatives.condition: Pre-medical applicants to NUST computing programmes who have not taken additional Mathematics must clear deficient Mathematics courses totalling 6 credit hours within one year.
conditional_subject_alternatives.required_follow_up: Confirm the current NUST remedial Mathematics requirements and deadlines.

rules.note: The published NUST computing table includes HSSC with Mathematics as a mandatory subject and the listed Pre-Engineering/Computer Science pathways. Foreign qualifications require IBCC equivalence. Minimum eligibility does not guarantee selection on merit.
